text:
mike: Hey team — quick permission check. Data team needs to pull ~30GB of app logs from project redwood-prod for an external data request. Can we grant one-off minimal console access rather than org-level roles? They need to run a logging read and export to a bucket we control. Proposed approach: create an ephemeral service account (sa-data-extract@...) with a narrow custom role (only the logging permissions needed) + storage.objectCreator on the destination bucket. TTL 4h. Thoughts?

tanvi: prefer JIT ephemeral SA via our JITA flow. don't grant roles/logging.viewer at project/org level. create a custom role scoped to the project with only the permissions: logging.logEntries.list, logging.logEntries.export (or equivalent), and storage.objects.create on the target bucket. require a ticket + privacy approval. TTL 4h is fine. also add condition on the binding if possible (e.g., requestor principal in condition). :white_check_mark:

sam: +1 to JIT. also we need a mandatory pre-export redaction step to strip PII (email, ip, user_ids). see runbook: https://internal/runbooks/log-redaction. recommend running redaction as a Cloud Run job that writes to the export bucket. bucket should have CMEK and retention.

mike: ok thanks. can someone paste the gcloud snippets I should use (or an infra job)? I'm not super comfortable creating custom roles manually.

security-bot: JITA ticket created: JITA-4021 by @mike. Status: pending approval. Attach your ticket with the requested destination bucket and sample redaction output.

tanvi: sample gcloud steps (example only):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts create sa-data-extract --project=redwood-prod

# create a project-scoped custom role with minimal logging perms
gcloud iam roles create customLogExportRole --project=redwood-prod \
  --title="Minimal Log Export" --permissions=logging.logEntries.list,logging.logEntries.create

# bind the custom role to the new service account
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:sa-data-extract@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="projects/redwood-prod/roles/customLogExportRole"

# grant write to destination bucket (only object create)
gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://redwood-privacy-exports \
  --member="serviceAccount:sa-data-extract@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/storage.objectCreator"
```

Note: do NOT grant roles/storage.admin or broad viewer roles. keep it minimal.

mike: perfect — thanks. on redaction, who runs that script?

sam: @infra-team owns the redaction job; we can run it on-demand. i'll trigger the Cloud Run redaction once JITA is approved and share sample output for tanvi to review.

tanvi: approve checklist for JITA: requester identity, justification, destination bucket + retention policy, minimal role yaml, sample redaction output. once those are attached i'll approve and set TTL to 4h.

mike: filing ticket now with the checklist. pinging privacy for approval. thanks all :thumbsup:

security-bot: JITA-4021 moved to 'approved' by @tanvi. TTL set to 4h.
